ventral_fluke_pixel_intensity_distributi.global_contrast_ratio: Low; approximately 0.10:0.90 ratio of high-intensity (light gray scars/mottling) to low-intensity (dark charcoal base) pixels across the visible surface.
ventral_fluke_pixel_intensity_distributi.spatial_color_mapping: Primary dark charcoal field with diffuse light-gray mottled patches in the central-right region and several distinct high-contrast linear streaks (scars) oriented diagonally across the lobe surface.

trailing_edge_2d_geometric_contour.edge_topography_serration_map: High-amplitude, irregular serrations featuring approximately 7 distinct peaks and deep V-shaped valleys along the distal half of the trailing edge; frequency increases significantly toward the tip.
trailing_edge_2d_geometric_contour.lobe_sweep_trajectory: Strongly convex curve along the leading edge tapering to a narrow, jagged distal tip.

localized_surface_anomalies.rosette_scar_constellations: Single high-contrast tan/orange circular pixel cluster (potential barnacle base or scar) located near the trailing edge in the distal region.
localized_surface_anomalies.linear_abrasions: Dense network of light-gray, non-parallel linear pixel disruptions (rake marks) concentrated in the central-distal area of the fluke lobe.

acquired_anomalies_or_scars: Significant irregular tissue loss and deep serrations along the trailing edge consistent with physical trauma or predation marks, plus prominent healed rake marks.
other_distinctive_markers: Highly irregular saw-tooth trailing edge profile and a specific prominent light-gray diagonal scar bisecting the central lobe area.
